scores.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong message names (`list_sessions` and `session_list` with `sessions` instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` with `conversations`) and interface names (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`). It completely missed the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in configuration, the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code, and `StoreCannotList`, and instead directly violated an explicit acceptance criterion by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when `store.listFor` is absent. Additionally, its validator accepts `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` (which the ticket explicitly requires rejecting), logs raw store error messages (which the ticket forbids to prevent leaking connection strings), and omits the `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md` updates. It also left an untracked `.lore/dod.md` file in the repository. On the positive side, it did handle the request off the per-session lock, ignored client-supplied `userId` in favor of the authenticated user, and used the composite `{updatedAt, sessionId}` cursor for `before`.
